name: Editorial portfolio / showcase
summary: Serif + sans typography, generous margins, case-study cards and a comfortable reading measure.
anatomy: Quiet header → statement → selected work as six results in a row that slides sideways → essay excerpt with pull quote → contact → footer
type: editorial: a soft, bookish serif for someone who writes as much as she designs, with a plain sans for the facts
motion: One scroll moment: the work slides sideways while the page scrolls down (side-scroll), each piece one measured result set large. A swipe row on phones; everything else is still.
composition: hero-cover: the name as a masthead, a date line, one picture and the cover line; the pill nav alone in the bar.
